questions.question_text:
$A$, $B$ and $C$ are three vertices of a rectangle whose sides are parallel to the axes.
Given $A(2,8)$, $B(7,8)$ and $C(2,3)$, what are the coordinates of the missing vertex $D$?
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.5]\draw (2,3) rectangle (7,8);\fill (2,8) circle (2pt) node[above] {$A$};\fill (7,8) circle (2pt) node[above] {$B$};\fill (2,3) circle (2pt) node[left] {$C$};\fill (7,3) circle (2pt) node[right] {$D$};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]

options.why: Found the missing corner's values but reversed the coordinate order, writing $y = 3$ before $x = 7$.
Used $B$'s $y$-coordinate $8$ instead of $C$'s $y$-coordinate $3$, repeating $B$.
Used $C$'s $x$-coordinate $2$ instead of $B$'s $x$-coordinate $7$, repeating $C$.

questions.solution_text: $D$ is directly below $B$, so it shares $B$'s $x$-coordinate: $x = 7$. It is directly right of $C$, so it shares $C$'s $y$-coordinate: $y = 3$. Therefore $D = (7,3)$.
